q: "He had eaten." Which form of tense does the sentence represent?
Fill in the blank: By the time she comes, we _________.
Fill in the gap with the right tense: Many years have passed since you ____ that place.
Identify the correct sentence.
o: Six weeks had gone by since I had started my new Job.
Six weeks have gone by since I started my new Job.
Six weeks has gone by since I started my new Job.
Six weeks have gone by since I have started my new Job.

q: Scarcely had the meeting begun when the electricity ______.
I ___ a letter before he arrived.
e: before-এর পরে arrived আছে, তাই আগের কাজটি past perfect হবে: had written। অর্থ: সে আসার আগেই আমি একটি চিঠি লিখে ফেলেছিলাম। wrote দিলে কাজ দুটির আগে-পরে স্পষ্ট হয় না। have written present perfect, অতীতের কাজের সাথে মেলে না। was writing চলমান কাজ বোঝায়, লেখা শেষ হওয়া বোঝায় না।

q: Just now she ____ her lunch, but she says she will see you when she's finished.
____ she ever driven a car?
Identify the sentence in Future Continuous Tense.
o: I will finish my homework tomorrow.
I will have finished my homework by 7 PM.
I am finishing my homework now.
I will be finishing my homework at 7 P.M.

q: She ________ in this company for five years.
I will go there after _______.
While I _____ to the shopping mall, I saw a beggar crying loudly in front of the mall.
By next week, we _____________ the new website.
She ________ her hands before she cooked the dinner.
I fell asleep while I ____________ TV.
Mr. Dulal called while you ___ lunch. (IU G 17-18)
e: একটি চলমান অতীত কাজের সময় অন্য ঘটনা ঘটলে চলমান অংশে Past Continuous বসে। Called ছোট ঘটনা, আর lunch নেওয়া তখন চলছিল। You-এর সাথে was নয়, were বসে, তাই were taking সঠিক। অর্থ: তুমি যখন দুপুরের খাবার খাচ্ছিলে তখন মি. দুলাল ফোন করেছিলেন। Took বসালে দুটি কাজই সম্পূর্ণ ও পরপর ঘটেছে এমন বোঝায়, যা এখানে অর্থ দেয় না।

q: I will eat breakfast after I _____________________.
16. It was long since his grandfather ____.
The family _____ their homeland during the 1990s.
As soon as he ___, I will tell you everything.
e:
'As soon as', 'when', 'before', 'after', 'until' সময়ের Clause ভবিষ্যৎ কাল বোঝালেও তাতে Present Indefinite Tense বসে। Will শুধু মূল Clause-এ (I will tell) থাকে। তাই এখানে comes।
মনে রাখুন:
Wait here until he returns.
When she arrives, we will start.
সময়ের Clause-এ will বসে না।
